northpeak.name: NorthPeak Outfitters
northpeak.account_notes: Largest account. Renewal in 6 weeks. Escalates hard and often; the CSM flags most escalations as 'perception, not incident'.

tidewater.name: Tidewater Supply
tidewater.account_notes: B2B wholesale. Low ticket volume, high signal. Files early and describes problems in future tense.

bloomvine.name: Bloom & Vine
bloomvine.account_notes: DTC homeware. Running a 48h flash sale; live GMV is roughly 13x their baseline and dwarfs their ARR-implied importance.

verdant.name: Verdant Home
verdant.account_notes: Credible reporter. Has been deprioritised repeatedly for eight weeks; CSM has raised it twice.

soloartisan.name: soloartisan
soloartisan.account_notes: Single-operator hobby store on the free plan. Files perhaps twice a year. Understates everything.

kitecopper.name: Kite & Copper
kitecopper.account_notes: High ticket volume, low resolution rate. Marks nearly everything critical.
